headline: Budget 2027: Schlein and Conte go on the attack. The Democratic Party leader: it must be entirely rewritten
summary: The leader of Italy's main opposition party, Elly Schlein, called for the 2027 budget presented by the government to be entirely rewritten. She described it as the last budget of the legislature.
why: Italy's budget plans shape its deficit, debt issuance and bond yields, which matter to euro-area sovereign debt investors.
